name: Push notifications (APNs)
description: Asks for notification permission, registers with APNs and exposes the device token to send to your server; your server sends pushes with an APNs key.

credentialsNeeded.description: Key ID of your APNs authentication key (.p8)

cost.note: Apple Developer Program membership needed for device builds and distribution; simulator builds are free; APNs itself has no per-message fee; your server sends the pushes

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Add `@UIApplicationDelegateAdaptor(PushAppDelegate.self) private var pushDelegate` to the App struct. Call `await PushRegistration.shared.requestAndRegister()` after the user opts in (not at launch). Observe `PushRegistration.shared.deviceToken` (hex string) and send it to your server, which sends notifications through APNs with the server-only key. The simulator can receive test pushes with `xcrun simctl push`.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify push-notifications` on a Mac.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
